learning_outcomes.text: Learns media literacy and its importance.
Learns the media literacy process in the world and in Turkey.
Learns the communication process, its elements, and types of communication.
Learns mass media, communication, and the relationship between mass communication.
Learns the functions and economic dimension of media.
Learns the development of television broadcasting in Turkey.
Learns the negative effects of television, TV program analyses, and warning symbols.

syllabus_topics: Media literacy process in the world and in Turkey
Communication process, its elements and communication
Mass media, communication and mass communication relationship
Family, child and television (TV viewing habits)
Negative effects of television, TV program analyses, warning symbols
Radio, its functions, radio program types and analyses
Periodicals, their functions, newspaper and magazine, basic concepts
Importance of news and photography in newspapers, newspaper preparation practice, magazine types
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
